doc_save.description: Save to its own file (an incremental update, which keeps signatures valid) or to a new path (a full rewrite). The write is atomic. flatten_fill_sign bakes Fill & Sign text, marks and signatures into the page first and removes those annotations; other comments and form fields stay. Omit it, or pass false, to leave them editable.

flatten_fill_sign.description: Bake Fill & Sign marks into the page before writing. Default false.

full.description: Force a full rewrite (or, with false, an incremental update).

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

link_list.name: link_list

text_find.description: Find a phrase (case-insensitive, whitespace-normalised) and return matches in page order with page and line rectangles in points (origin top-left). Reads growing batches, looking one match past the limit for a continuation. Failed pages do not discard readable matches: warnings contains up to 100 {page, error, error_truncated} entries (errors capped at 1024 UTF-8 bytes), warning_count counts failed pages, and warnings_truncated reports a capped list. complete is false after a page failure or when more matches exist; next is present only for a match-limit continuation.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

limit.description: Maximum matches (default 500). When another match exists, next holds start_page and skip to continue. complete is false for either additional matches or failed pages; an exhausted search with warnings has no next.

skip.description: Matches to pass over on start_page before returning any (default 0).

text_find.name: text_find
